title: synotis duclouxii
intro: Synotis duclouxii, commonly known as the Ducloux's Synotis or Ducloux's synotis, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Synotis duclouxii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Synotis duclouxii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
